stories.title: ‘Almost impassable’: DNR lieutenant describes search for 83-year-old hunter found alive
stories.summary: Search teams worked section by section through a thick swamp before hearing the missing hunter call for help. A DNR lieutenant shares how crews made it happen.

stories.title: Amway Stadium will host Michigan vs. Michigan State soccer game in April
stories.summary: Tickets for the game go on sale Friday at 10 a.m. The game is scheduled for 1:15 p.m. on April 10.

stories.title: Artists wanted to create new work for MLK Park Community Center
stories.summary: Parks and Recreation is partnering with Muse GR to find artists to create pieces that celebrate "the past, present and future of this space and neighborhood."

stories.title: West Michigan food pantries face increased demand amid SNAP cuts, rising costs
stories.summary: Cuts to SNAP benefits in West Michigan are impacting over 10,000 residents, driving increased reliance on food pantries and revealing broader economic consequences.

stories.title: Rockford hunter trips, accidentally shoots self in foot
stories.summary: Law enforcement are reminding hunters to take precautions while hunting and always practice firearm safety.

stories.summary: This holiday season, the Kent County Department of Public Works aims to reduce landfill waste by encouraging residents to recycle more.

stories.title: Grand Rapids coffee shop to close after 33 years
